name: engineer
description: The iteration engineer — one bounded, spec-driven pass toward a goal per run. Owns the HOW, never the WHAT: works from your goal's success criteria, keeps tasks in a beads ledger when present, measures state with deterministic sh (state.sh) and commits only on a green gate (gate.sh). Modes: sdd none (pure Ralph) | light (acceptance criteria on every task). Full SDD + hooks enforcement + the spec agent live in engineer-pro.
